name: Mars Mission: Escape from Jezero Crater
author: NathanBrower
description:
LEGO Ideas Username: Nathan Brower
The year is 2295, and Jezero Crater Colony is under attack! As an unmanned reconnaissance drone, it is your mission to protect the Escape Rocket from incoming Hostiles by collecting Studs and activating Defence Turrets. The fate of the colonists' is in your hands!
___

Controls:
TAB - Pause / How to Play
WASD - Move
Mouse - Look
Space - Jump
E - Spend Studs to Active Turret
___

Thanks for checking out my game! I really had a great time creating this. The LEGO Microgame is a powerful toolset, and I look forward to what the future will bring.

Note - All non prepackaged sounds are either created by me, or in the public domain.

Cheers, and enjoy!
